name: @bem-broom/core
description: Utility for generating and parsing BEM class names using JS objects
author: Preston Goforth

scripts.build: rimraf ./dist && npm run build:modern && npm run build:legacy && npm run build:min && tsc
scripts.build:modern: npm run build:modern:cjs && npm run build:modern:esm
scripts.build:modern:cjs: NODE_ENV=production BROWSERSLIST_ENV=modern BABEL_ENV=commonjs babel src --out-dir dist/modern --out-file-extension .cjs --ignore "**/*.test.js,**/__tests__/**,**/*.spec.js,**/types.js"
scripts.build:modern:esm: NODE_ENV=production BROWSERSLIST_ENV=modern BABEL_ENV=esm babel src --out-dir dist/modern --out-file-extension .mjs --ignore "**/*.test.js,**/__tests__/**,**/*.spec.js,**/types.js"
scripts.build:legacy: npm run build:legacy:cjs && npm run build:legacy:esm
scripts.build:legacy:cjs: NODE_ENV=production BROWSERSLIST_ENV=legacy BABEL_ENV=commonjs babel src --out-dir dist/legacy --out-file-extension .cjs --ignore "**/*.test.js,**/__tests__/**,**/*.spec.js,**/types.js"
scripts.build:legacy:esm: NODE_ENV=production BROWSERSLIST_ENV=legacy BABEL_ENV=esm babel src --out-dir dist/legacy --out-file-extension .mjs --ignore "**/*.test.js,**/__tests__/**,**/*.spec.js,**/types.js"
